value.rationale: The chain triangular cactus is a standard and motivated cyclic block family; the exact primitive temporal orbit count is a natural recurrence invariant not equal to ordinary domination counts or mere existence/activity. A nontrivial two-state local-support reduction yields the surprisingly small recurrence and golden-ratio-cubed exponential rate for every chain length, exposing quantitative sensitivity to the manner in which triangle motifs are connected. The result does not require an unproved downstream application.
